entities.summary: Clara E. Mattei is an Italian economist and academic, specializing in the history of capitalism and the interplay between economic theories and technocratic policymaking. Since February 2025, she has served as Professor of Economics and Director of the Forum for Real Economic Emancipation at the University of Tulsa, Oklahoma in the United States.
